items.claim: SSA states Social Security Disability Insurance provides monthly payments to people who have a disability that stops or limits their ability to work, and eligibility requires a disability or blindness and enough work history.

SSA states applicants can apply for disability benefits online, and the online path is described for adults 18 or older who are unable to work because of a medical condition expected to last at least 12 months or result in death.
SSA states SSDI benefits have a five-month waiting period, so payments will not begin before the sixth full month of disability, with a published ALS exception on or after July 23, 2020.
SSA FAQ states people may apply online or call 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778) Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
